_doc: rsk-clients-lab settings. Read by bin/*.py and bin/*.sh. README.md explains the method.

mainnet-sim.description: k6 option 14 (mainnet-sim): storage writes, ERC-20, native transfers and calldata-heavy rollup txs, about 164 txs per block

ecdsa.description: k6 option 7 (CPU ECDSA): signature-recovery-heavy contract calls, almost all of each block is transaction execution

mainnet-sim@mainnet.description: k6 option 14 (mainnet-sim): storage writes, ERC-20, native transfers and calldata-heavy rollup txs, about 164 txs per block, mined on the mainnet seed

ecdsa@mainnet.description: k6 option 7 (CPU ECDSA): signature-recovery-heavy contract calls, almost all of each block is transaction execution, mined on the mainnet seed
ecdsa@mainnet._doc: first_block/last_block are filled from samples/<name>/meta.json once bin/build-mainnet-sample.sh has run

machines._doc: Locks in ~/.research-lab/locks (bin/lib.sh), shared with any other lab that uses this Mac's Docker VM or the Boton boxes. A campaign holds this Mac's Docker slot as a long holder, so another lab's short jobs go first.

mainnet_seed._doc: The mainnet seed (database-seed/, the rsk-database-seed tooling): RSKj's seed at /seed in the volume, rustock's converted seed at /rustock_seed; runs use hard-link clones in the same volume. seed_tooling is the submodule prepare.sh and clone.sh live in (seeds/mainnet/{meta.json,node.props} describe the seed); k6 is the rskj-k6-tests submodule live arms drive the node with (bin/live-arm.sh); runtime_image is built from docker/runtime/Dockerfile.

live._doc: Live mining arms (bin/live-arm.sh, docs/live-mining-plan.md): each client mines its own blocks under k6 for arm_minutes, in a container with these limits (2 CPUs; 10 GB on the mainnet seed). The first min_block blocks of every arm are dropped (k6 deploys its contracts there); an arm counts only with min_qualifying_blocks blocks at least threshold full, a k6 success rate (k6_success_metric per k6 option, from the k6 summary) of at least k6_min_success_pct, and its blocks replayed into the other client with the same hashes. mining_coinbase is where rustock sends block rewards (RSKj derives its own from miner.coinbase.secret); REMASC pays either out 4000 blocks later, so neither arm sees the reward.
live.k6_gas_price_doc: GAS_PRICE_RULE for the k6 suite: 'head-minimum-x1.1' prices every transaction at the head block's minimumGasPrice times 1.1 on both arms (rskj's own eth_gasPrice rule while the fee market is not working); 'node' asks each client's eth_gasPrice. Pinned since 2026-10-28-c6: rustock's eth_gasPrice follows the seed's history and its miner does not apply the RSKIP252 cap (docs/live-mining-plan.md).
